human_tolerance.notes: Common in secondary forest, shady plantations, and brushy pastures and gardens near forest (Wikipedia, citing Birds of the World).

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Breeding season spans March to August in Costa Rica (Birds of the World, via Wikipedia); not fully defined.

vocalizations.description: Long series of variations, described as a 'long series of variations on high tjúrewur witjewúr' and as a mellow, caroling phrase series; sung by both sexes (Wikipedia, citing van Perlo 2009 and Schulenberg et al. 2010).
A metallic 'tick', a high 'seek' and a mewing 'CHEEluloo' call (Wikipedia, citing Schulenberg et al. 2010). The sources do not name an alarm call; assigning these to the alarm context is judgement.

conservation.note: IUCN Least Concern as cited in the Wikipedia article.

range.note: Country list derived from the article's subspecies distribution text: Mexico, every Central American country except El Salvador, and mainland South American countries except Argentina, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay. Paraguay is excluded because the article notes the South American committee has no records there. Costa Rica is native; no introduced range was assessed.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Flight is documented; the article does not describe hopping. Hop is included because the shared perching-songbird behaviour feeds with a hop gait, which the species is judged to use on branches; this is judgement.

traits.flight.note: Powered flight, as for passerines generally; the article gives no separate statement.

traits.respiration.note: Lungs, as for all birds; no sourced statement for this species.

traits.metamorphosis.note: None, as for all birds; no sourced statement for this species.

traits.nest_type.note: Bulky cup of plant material in a bush or tree, 0.3 to 2 m above ground and sometimes up to 9 m (Birds of the World, via Wikipedia).

traits.perching.note: Passerine; nests and forages in bushes and trees.

traits.size_class.note: Derived from mass_kg (0.0476 kg, below the 0.05 kg Tiny threshold).

traits.mass_kg.note: Scholer dataset row X=614 gives mass 47.62 g for this species; the Wikipedia article gives male and female averages of about 46 g and 49 g (Birds of the World). The dataset mass is a single tabulated value of unstated population and method.

traits.length_m.note: 'About 20 cm long' (van Perlo 2009, cited in Wikipedia); rounded value, not a measured mean.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Proxy, not a measured lifespan. Input: annual apparent survival S = 0.61 for Saltator maximus, dataset row X=614 (ref Martin et al. 2015; Yacumbu National Park, Venezuela; mark-resight; duration 7 years; the dataset's se column reads 0.249, scale not documented in the file). Equation: lifespan = -1 / ln(S) = -1 / ln(0.61) = 2.02 years, rounded to 2.0. Assumptions and limits: a constant-survival model; adult survival only, so first-year mortality is not included; apparent survival is biased low by emigration, which would make the true lifespan longer; one Venezuelan population stands in for Costa Rica; the 95% range implied by se is very wide. Maximum and captive ages were not used. Not for use as a published typical lifespan without the caveat.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits SpecID 13290: Diet-Inv 60, Diet-Fruit 30, Diet-Nect 10, Diet-Certainty A. Conflict: the Wikipedia article (Birds of the World) says the species feeds primarily on plant material (fruit, flowers, nectar) and also includes insects. This record keeps the quantitative EltonTraits split and flags the conflict for review.

traits.social.note: 'Usually seen in pairs'; group_size [2,2] is a judgement from that statement.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Authored: diurnal passerine that forages and sings in daylight. The sources consulted do not state a daily pattern; EltonTraits Nocturnal is not present in this species' row.

traits.defense.note: Authored: flees to cover, as for small passerines. No sourced statement.

traits.wariness.note: Authored judgement; the article describes birds in gardens and near forest but does not quantify wariness.

habitat.use.note: EltonTraits ForStrat: ground 20; understory 40, midhigh 20 and canopy 20 mapped to arboreal (80).

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Authored mapping of forest-edge and brushy-thicket habitat to shrub_thicket.

habitat.resources.note: Weights follow the EltonTraits diet split; nest_cup follows the nest description; perch and shrub_thicket are authored.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Use of gardens, plantations and brushy pastures near forest from Wikipedia; urban_affinity Adapter is a judgement.

seasonal.phases.note: Costa Rica breeding season March to August as stated in the article (Birds of the World); the article says the season is not fully defined.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Adult only; juvenile stage durations are not sourced for this species.

vocalizations.song.note: Descriptions quoted in the article; season_months empty means no seasonal restriction was sourced.

vocalizations.alarm.note: Calls are described in the article; assigning the alarm context is judgement.

look.note: Olive-green upperparts, grey crown and breast, buffy throat and belly, black bill (nominate subspecies, from Wikipedia); proportions and palette tones are authored judgement.

behavior.note: Local program bt-saltator-maximus-v1: copy of the shared bt-perching-songbird-v1 with the nesting months set to 3-8 (Costa Rica breeding season). See behavior.json.
